$comment: BYOC shared conformance vectors for RFC 3986 path encoding. This determines the actual S3 object key and WebDAV URL a file is stored under. Drift here means one SDK writes to a key another SDK cannot address. Unreserved characters (A-Za-z0-9 and - . _ ~) MUST pass through unencoded; everything else MUST be percent-encoded with uppercase hex.

rfc3986_uri_encode.$comment: rfc3986UriEncode(input, encode_slash) -> expected. Note that ! ' ( ) * are encoded even though encodeURIComponent in JavaScript leaves them alone; implementations must not rely on a language's built-in URL escaper without checking this set.

cases.note: tilde is unreserved in RFC 3986 and must NOT be encoded

encode_path_segments.$comment: encodePathSegments(input) -> expected. Splits on '/', encodes each segment with encode_slash=true, rejoins with '/'. Leading and trailing slashes are trimmed. It does NOT collapse duplicate interior slashes -- that is normalizeVirtualPath's job, and encoding is always applied to an already-normalized path.

cases.note: the '#' truncation bug this fixture exists to prevent
the '?' truncation bug this fixture exists to prevent
interior duplicate slashes are preserved, not collapsed
